name: Ansvar AI
description:
Run regulated security and privacy work inside Claude, with every claim traced to a source you can show an auditor.

Ansvar answers questions on NIS2, DORA, GDPR, the EU AI Act, the Cyber Resilience Act (CRA) and national transpositions such as Sweden's Cybersäkerhetslagen, then runs the work built on them: gap analysis, DPIA, FRIA, LINDDUN privacy threat modelling, STRIDE threat models, and automotive TARA under ISO/SAE 21434 and UNECE R155/R156.

Ask things like:
"Does NIS2 apply to a 60-person SaaS provider in Sweden?"
"Compare incident-reporting deadlines under DORA and NIS2."
"Map our ISO 27001 controls to CRA vulnerability-handling obligations."
"Is this citation still in force?"
"What changed in German cybersecurity law this quarter?"
"Draft a DPIA for our new HR analytics tool."
"Score this CVE for an internet-facing system that can't be patched yet."

Vulnerability intelligence is built in: CVE lookup, CVSS environmental scoring, EPSS, CISA KEV status, public exploit references, and VEX export.

Coverage: 46 licensing-audited jurisdictions, 262 security frameworks, 5.7M citable legal provisions, court decisions and regulator guidance — plus licensed clause text for ISO/IEC 27001, 27002, 27005, 42001 and ISO/SAE 21434 through SIS (Swedish Institute for Standards). Nothing is scraped.

Upload your own policies, contracts or tenders and get paragraph-level, hash-anchored citations that stay provable months later. Where no verified source exists, Ansvar marks the gap instead of papering over it. Grounded, not generated.

Built for Legal professionals, CISOs, DPOs, GRC teams, security architects and consultants who need answers they can defend.

EU-hosted core. OAuth 2.1. Nothing you send trains anyone's model. Free to start, no card required.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Ansvar AI to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Ansvar AI to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://gateway.ansvar.eu/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Ansvar AI MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Ansvar AI lists 61 MCP tools, including batch_search, cancel_workflow, check_applicability, check_kev_status, compare_requirements, create_dfd, decrypt_receipt, delete_my_document, describe_capabilities, diff, effective_risk, and effective_risk_inline.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Ansvar AI?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Ansvar AI in legal on the Manufact MCP catalog include GVRN Company Incorporation MCP, Alizé, Casepoint, CiteLaw, and CookieYes.

_published_faq.name: Does Ansvar AI MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Ansvar AI requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Ansvar AI is developed by Ansvar AI. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
